title: Grilled Za'atar Chicken, Lemon Sorbet and More Alfresco Daydreams
snippet: Good morning! Today we have for you: Grilled za'atar chicken with garlicky yogurt and cilantro. A punchy cucumber-tomato-onion salad to serve alongside it.
